$comment: earmilk colorways. Source: the README's Colorways table and Amendments, and the Flavors artboard on the canvas. Hex, sRGB. 'order' is the lineup order. Since 2026-10-02 there is no sleeve: 'board' is the body finish and 'print' the accent finish. 'lid' is 'print' where the gable and fin take the accent colour and 'board' where they stay the body colour. 'plinth' is the built-in 110 mm base in the accent colour; 'badge' is the metal wordmark on its front. Values under 'asDrawn' are read off the canvas illustrations and are reference only.
rules: No sleeve: the colours are a finish on the birch cabinet, fixed per speaker.
Whole, 2% and Skim carry the gable and fin in the accent colour; Chocolate and Oat stay one colour, gable included.
The bottom 110 mm is a built-in plinth in the accent colour on all four sides, with a 3 mm shadow line above it.
The wordmark is cast metal lettering standing on the plinth's front, no plate, and an engraving on the back panel above the Nutrition Facts. Nothing on the sides, nothing under the gable.
Bare birch shows only on the back panel and in the bowl's exploded or section views.
The throat is painted, light at the mouth to dark at the throat.
Flavor is the colorway only. One voicing.
Two printed marks are spec: OPEN OTHER SIDE on the back slope and SHAKE WELL by the port. Nothing else is printed.

plinth.finish: accent colour, all four sides, flush with the body

backPanel.bronze: an engraved bronze plate, the Facts panel plus a 26 mm margin (x 36 to 354, z 504 to 796), 3 mm thick, 1.5 mm proud; port, posts and the cast letters on the finish outside it
backPanel.label: the same extent as a bare birch field (option)
backPanel.full: a bare birch field x 26 to 364, z 140 to 830 (option)

backBadge.type: cast metal letters, as the front

openOtherSide.where: back slope of the gable, centred
openOtherSide.ink: the gable's other colour: board on the white flavours, accent on Chocolate and Oat

shakeWell.where: back, centred at z 300, under the port
